reason: The company secured a new order worth Rs. 87.53 Crores for Type IV Composite CNG Cylinders, which provides a direct, measurable boost to near-term revenue and confirms demand in the CGD network sector.
why_now: The order was officially disclosed in an exchange filing on 2026-08-31.
source_headlines: Time Technoplast Limited: Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about securing order of Rs. 87.53 Crores for supply of Type IV Composite CNG Cylinders - Mobile Storage Cascades for CNG and CGD Network from Well-Established Public Sector Undertaking (PSU)
